name: Return-vs-Volatility Alternative Views (Rolling Sharpe + Max Drawdown)
description: Extend the Model Portfolios Return vs Volatility panel with two alternative time-series views switchable via the canonical Segment Analytics-style toggle: (1) Rolling Sharpe Ratio (90D/180D/365D apertures, 10Y Treasury RFR from data.pkl); (2) Maximum Drawdown (90D/180D/365D/SI apertures). Models render in canonical colors, benchmarks in gray. Daily granularity throughout. Sharpe + drawdown computed frontend; backend extends yang-model-portfolio-benchmarks Lambda to emit a daily timeseries JSON including 10Y Treasury yield.
phase: Phase 1 COMPLETE 2026-05-04 — 5/5 TOs shipped same-day (PRD-to-PROD ~9h burst). **TO-1 RFR spec** (AE 0.5 `697e29e7e`+`80250df90`). **TO-3 Lambda emit** (AE 0.5 `e2f0a8077` `yang-v2.3.9`; rev `2c18f0c06` `yang-v2.4.0` duration-matched per-model RFR). **TO-2 DE toggle + Sharpe + Drawdown stub-driven** (DE 0.4 portal-v2.1.71 + polish v2.1.72/73/74; status flip `225bc1982` 5 acceptance-flexes documented). **TO-4 DE wire-up + spot-check** (chart entry-counts 22/65/131/261 to match weekday-only timeseries; month-end x-tick formatting; manual Sharpe spot-check arithmetic embedded). **TO-5 Up/Down Capture rolling view** (DE 0.4 `034b29d9e` + portal `d1e66357` RollingCaptureChart; y-axis frame-active-data improvement `5a28f128`; deploy via DT 0.4 portal-v2.1.75 bump `2f4370f89`). yang-pipeline term_returns weekend+holiday-row dropouts `1c80f15e7`+`cdc2271c4` aligned rolling Sharpe to clean 252 trading days/year. **4-view toggle live in PROD** (Scatter / Rolling Sharpe / Up-Down Capture / Max Drawdown).
pipeline: yang-pipeline (model_portfolio_benchmarks Lambda extension) + portal frontend (ReturnVolatilityScatter refactor + 2 new chart components)
